dataset_rationale: Curated GraphCAG drift-probe set with exact-hit, near-hit, and unsafe drift cases labeled for PCC evaluation.

protocol.candidate_pool: same benchmark-provided documents for all modes
protocol.hipporag_proxy: memory-propagation proxy over the candidate graph; not a full HippoRAG implementation
protocol.state_drift_note: PCC metrics (Precision, Recall, Level Isolation, Drift Detection, Incorrect Reuse Rate) are central to GraphCAG. Vanilla CAG can still be scored as a cache baseline, while HippoRAG proxy has no equivalent state-aware cache and reports N/A.

state_drift_label_schema.expected_safe_reuse: boolean; whether PCC should allow reuse on this probe
state_drift_label_schema.expected_level_isolation: boolean; whether source and request level should match
state_drift_label_schema.cached_level: level associated with the reused candidate, when known

protocol.state_drift_metric_policy: When drift labels are present in dataset or pipeline metadata, PCC metrics are computed from those labels. Otherwise the harness falls back to answer-quality heuristics so the report remains usable as a lower-bound cache study.

modes.name: cag_vanilla
modes.label: Vanilla CAG
modes.description: Flat reusable-context baseline without graph-indexed modular reuse.

modes.name: hipporag_proxy
modes.label: HippoRAG proxy
modes.description: Memory-propagation proxy over the candidate graph, not a full HippoRAG implementation.

modes.name: graphcag_rapid
modes.label: GraphCAG
modes.description: Graph-aware ranking plus RAPID cache, intended as the main GraphCAG mode.

state_drift_metric_basis.labels: Preferred. Uses explicit drift annotations from benchmark metadata.
state_drift_metric_basis.quality-fallback: Fallback. Uses token F1 threshold when explicit drift labels are unavailable.

prompt_accounting_policy.provider: Preferred. Reads prompt/completion/cached token fields when the serving backend exposes them.
prompt_accounting_policy.estimated: Fallback. Estimates prompt and completion tokens from text when provider usage is unavailable; cached tokens remain zero.
